name: Volume-Augmented NeRF
definition: A neural network architecture that infers fluid dynamics by combining a volume-augmented NeRF renderer with a differentiable fluid simulator. It takes positional encoded point x, camera view d, and fluid volume v as inputs to output density σ and RGB color c.
summary: Volume-Augmented NeRF renders dynamic fluid scenes by incorporating explicit fluid volume values as a third input alongside position and view direction to model temporal density changes.
